dashboard.title: Overview
dashboard.description: Track your sales, orders, and business performance.
dashboard.salesOverviewDescription: Sales performance over the last 7 days.

products.title: Products
products.description: Manage your products, pricing, and inventory.
products.catalogDescription: Your current products and inventory levels.
products.performanceNote: Sales and profit count delivered orders only
products.basicInformationDescription: Enter the basic details of your product.
products.updateBasicInformationDescription: Update the basic details of your product.
products.pricingInventoryDescription: Set the selling price, product cost, and available stock.
products.updatePricingInventoryDescription: Update the selling price, product cost, and available stock.
products.name: Product Name
products.marginDescription: Based on the selling price and product cost.
products.addDescription: Add a new product to your inventory.

detail.deliveredOnly: Sales figures count delivered orders only

detail.attentionNeverSold: No delivered sales recorded for this product yet
detail.attentionSoldBelow: Sold on average {amount} below the default price
detail.attentionLoss: This product is losing money after delivery cost

detail.deliveryCollectedNote: A further {amount} of delivery was collected from customers. It is not part of product sales.

detail.trendDescription: {count} units sold in the selected period

validation.pricePositive: Selling price must be greater than 0.
validation.costLowerThanPrice: Cost must be lower than the selling price.

productCampaigns.title: Advertising campaigns
productCampaigns.description: Link this product to any campaigns it supports. Campaigns remain linked to every selected product.
productCampaigns.noCampaigns: No advertising campaigns are available yet.

productProfitability.campaignsDescription: Historical allocated spend follows saved campaign-product snapshots. It is an estimate, not product-level ad attribution.
productProfitability.noCampaigns: No campaigns are linked to this product.
productProfitability.ordersDescription: Revenue and unit cost use the price and cost saved on each order item.

campaignDetails.productsDescription: Current links affect future allocations only. Saved historical allocations remain unchanged.
campaignDetails.historicalAllocationsDescription: Saved product identities and spend allocations are unchanged by current campaign links.

catalogState.deleted: Deleted / no longer available from Windsor

orders.title: Orders
orders.description: Manage your orders and track their status.
orders.allOrdersDescription: View and manage all customer orders.
orders.searchPlaceholder: Search by customer, phone or product...

delete.title: Delete Order
delete.description: Review the order before permanently deleting it.
delete.warningDescription: This action cannot be undone. The order will be permanently removed from your records.

edit.title: Edit Order
edit.description: Update order information and product details.
edit.notFoundDescription: The order could not be loaded.
edit.cannotEditDescription: Only pending orders can be edited. {status} orders are historical records, so their products, prices, and profit stay unchanged.
edit.productsDescription: Adjust products, quantities, or negotiated prices.

orderForm.productsDescription: Add the products in this order. You can adjust the price per unit for special deals.
orderForm.deliveryDescription: What the customer pays vs. what you pay the courier.
orderForm.deliveryChargedHint: Use 0 if delivery is included in the price.
orderForm.deliveryCostHint: What you pay the delivery company.
orderForm.selectForSummary: Select a product to see the summary.

validation.quantityWhole: Quantity must be a positive whole number.
validation.unitPricePositive: Unit price must be greater than 0.

reports.title: Reports
reports.description: Sales, profit, and order performance for your business.
reports.salesProfitAllTime: Daily product sales and profit across all available history.
reports.emptyDescription: Reports will appear here once you start creating orders.
reports.activeOrdersHint: {count, plural, one {# active order} other {# active orders}}
reports.salesProfitDescription: Daily performance over the last {range} days.
reports.businessSnapshotDescription: Key operational metrics for the selected period.
reports.moneyFlowDescription: Completed sales from delivered orders. Delivery charged to customers is shown separately and is not product sales.
reports.netMarginHint: {value}% of product sales left after all costs
reports.deliveryCollectedNote: {amount} of delivery was collected from customers and is not counted as product sales.

advertising.title: Advertising
advertising.description: Track what you spend on ads so net profit stays honest.
advertising.emptyDescription: Add what you spend on ads to see your real net profit.
advertising.performanceDescription: Is the advertising paying for itself? Delivered orders only.

verdictNext.scale: Ads cost less than half of what each order earns. Safe to increase the budget.
verdictNext.watch: Ads cost between half and all of each order's profit. Keep watching before scaling.
verdictNext.losing: Ads cost more than each order earns. Pause them or fix the campaigns first.
verdictNext.noData: Add ad spend and record some delivered orders to get a verdict.

verdictReason.noDeliveredOrders: There are no delivered orders in this period yet.
verdictReason.noAdSpend: No ad spend was recorded in this period.
verdictReason.noProfitBaseline: There is no positive profit in this period to compare against.

advertising.profitBasisNote: Profit is product profit, the same figure as the Reports page (delivery fees collected are not included).

windsor.title: Sync from Windsor
windsor.description: Pull Meta (Facebook/Instagram) ad spend from Windsor.ai. Manual entries are never changed.
windsor.noRows: Windsor returned no data for this period.
windsor.currencyNote: Windsor reported {amount} {currency} for this period. Converted at {rate} and stored in USD.
windsor.manualCoexist: You also have {count} manual entries ({amount}) in this period. They are a separate ad account, so they are ADDED to the Windsor spend.
windsor.fullPeriodHint: Preview fetches everything Windsor has for both connections. No date range is needed.

advertising.manualDescription: Expenses you added yourself. They are separate from Windsor and included in the grand total.
advertising.manualEmptyDescription: Add an expense to track spend that is not in Windsor.
advertising.summaryNote: All available data. Windsor + manual, counted once.
advertising.listDescription: Every advertising expense record, newest first.
advertising.currencyBasisNote: Windsor reports in {currency} and is converted at a fixed {rate}. Manual entries are already in USD. Total = Windsor USD + Manual USD.
advertising.allAvailableNote: All available data from both Windsor connections. No date limit.
advertising.noAttributionNote: Orders per message is a period-level ratio. We do not know which order came from which campaign, so no campaign is credited with any order.
